role: Graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson - expression of interest (Melbourne)
subject: Graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson EOI, Melbourne, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to a named vacancy. Your contact page invites people to connect with the Recruitment Team at recruitment@reedsconsulting.com.au, and your careers page asks for an EOI when no vacancy is listed. I am writing about graduate civil engineering or civil drafting work in Melbourne.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project in charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment, so mentoring on land development civil design or drafting is what I am looking for.

Reeds covers surveying, civil engineering, planning and development consulting from Swanston Street and Hallam.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

paragraphs: This is a speculative enquiry. Your contact page asks people to connect with the Recruitment Team at recruitment@reedsconsulting.com.au, and your careers page invites an EOI when you are not advertising a vacancy, including Graduate Work Experience. I am interested in graduate civil engineering or civil drafting work with your Melbourne team on land development projects.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with Australian Standards and Austroads guides, Before You Dig Australia enquiries, cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site, material and progress reports.

I have no Australian consulting employment yet. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I would be glad to hear if a Melbourne graduate or drafting path is open now or later.
